svg.title: Inversion: moving the lower note up an octave
svg.desc: Three pairs. Take the lower note and move it up an octave. A minor third of 3 semitones (C to E-flat) becomes a major sixth of 9 (E-flat to C). A major third of 4 becomes a minor sixth of 8. A perfect fourth of 5 becomes a perfect fifth of 7. Each pair adds to 12 semitones; the interval numbers add to 9.
